cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(TigirlKenLM LANGUAGES CXX)
file(GLOB sources lm/*.cc util/*.cc util/double-conversion/*.cc)
list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "(_test|_main)\\.cc$")
add_library(tigirl_kenlm STATIC ${sources})
target_include_directories(tigirl_kenlm PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set_property(TARGET tigirl_kenlm PROPERTY CXX_STANDARD 14)
target_compile_definitions(tigirl_kenlm PUBLIC KENLM_MAX_ORDER=6)
if(MSVC)
  set_property(TARGET tigirl_kenlm PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
  target_compile_definitions(tigirl_kenlm PRIVATE NOMINMAX _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
  target_compile_options(tigirl_kenlm PRIVATE /utf-8)
  target_link_libraries(tigirl_kenlm PUBLIC psapi)
else()
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  target_link_libraries(tigirl_kenlm PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
endif()
